allowed_claims_after_success: v2 improves on v1 on an independent cohort (H1)
v2 preserves the accuracy of the best fixed policy within 0.005 (H2)

cohort_specification.cohort_size: an outcome of the procedure, never a parameter; no first-N, no random sampling
cohort_specification.data_check: each dataset is re-downloaded and its data_sha256 must equal the S04 inspection record; mismatch => DATA_ERROR, recorded, not replaced
exclusions_in_order: any dataset whose data_sha256 equals that of a S04 cohort member (exact content duplicate)
any dataset sharing an OpenML name with a S04 cohort member (version families; independence rule)
exact-content duplicates within the remaining set (keep one by the S04 tier cascade)
cohort_specification.no_outcome_use: no model output of any version may enter cohort selection
cohort_specification.selection: apply the S04 deterministic primary-group and secondary-refinement procedure UNCHANGED (same bins, k1/k2 rules, tier cascade, diversity step, coverage audit, independent audit) to the remaining set
cohort_specification.universe: S04 eligibility_table.csv rows with eligible == True (frozen OpenML snapshot; no re-query of OpenML metadata)

disallowed_claims: the architecture, rather than the candidate library, drives performance
any claim from the S04-cohort v2 numbers as confirmatory

estimands.E1: mu1 = mean over triggered datasets of [bAcc(v2) - bAcc(v1)]
estimands.E2: mu2 = mean over triggered datasets of [bAcc(v2) - bAcc(Always-SMOTE+RF)]
estimands.E3: mu3 = mean over triggered datasets of [bAcc(v2) - bAcc(RF baseline)]  (replication of the S04 effect)
estimands.case_inclusion: cases with training IR >= 3.0 for which BOTH compared variants produced a committed structure; NOT_TRIGGERED never counted as zero; REJECTED reported separately
estimands.unit: dataset (mean over the SUCCESS cases of the dataset); case-level results are descriptive only

evidence_chain.rule: each lock is recomputed from the file on disk before use; mismatch aborts

execution.metric: balanced accuracy on the held-out fold
execution.selection_data: inner validation split of the training partition only (test fold untouched until the structure is fixed)
variants_run_on_every_case: Oracle (better of the two library candidates, evaluated on the test fold; diagnostic only, never used for selection)

external_registration.deposit: this JSON + its SHA-256 + the freeze addendum, before the first confirmatory download

forbidden: any edit to src_v2 after freeze
changing seeds, folds, thresholds, weights after freeze
frozen_code.freeze_rule: SHA-256 of every file in src/ and src_v2/ is computed and written to an addendum (protocol_freeze_addendum.json) that is deposited with the registration BEFORE the first confirmatory download. No code change is allowed afterwards.
frozen_code.v1_reference: src/ at the S04 source lock

H1.success: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND lower bound of the dataset-level bootstrap 95% CI of mu1 >= SESOI
H1.test: exact Wilcoxon signed-rank on dataset means, two-sided

H2.claim: v2 is non-inferior to Always-SMOTE+RF (governance does not cost accuracy)
H2.reading: success means 'the Arbiter preserves the accuracy of the best fixed policy', not 'the architecture outperforms it'
H2.success: 95% bootstrap CI of mu2 lies within [-0.005, +0.005]; superiority is NOT claimed even if mu2 > 0 unless a separate pre-specified superiority test (same Holm family) passes
H2.test: TOST at the dataset level with margin delta = 0.005 (two one-sided Wilcoxon/t checks, bootstrap CI inside [-0.005, +0.005] is the decision criterion)

H3.claim: v2 improves on the RF baseline (replication of S04)
H3.status: replication check, not part of the Holm family

hypotheses_and_decision_rules.claim_rule: 'significant' only if the rule above is met; otherwise 'no significant difference detected' / 'not demonstrated'
hypotheses_and_decision_rules.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni over {H1, H2}; H3 is a replication check reported separately
hypotheses_and_decision_rules.null_policy: a failed hypothesis is reported as a null finding; no re-run, no alternative configuration

operational_definitions.Mode_B_counts: computed by a script from the JSONL records; counts and rates reported per variant and per IR tercile
operational_definitions.negative_case: SUCCESS case with delta_bacc < 0 relative to the RF baseline
operational_definitions.utility_tied: |U(GB) - U(SMOTE_RF)| < 1e-12 on the inner validation split

power_analysis.decision: cohort size is NOT adjusted to the power result. If the procedure yields fewer triggered datasets than required, the study is run anyway and the achieved power is reported.

effect_scenarios: 100% and 50% of the v2 dataset-level mean difference observed on the S04 cohort (50% = optimism discount)
inputs.sd: dataset-level SD of v2-v1 differences from the S04-cohort v2 artifacts, read at run time from files
inputs.trigger_rate: share of datasets with at least one triggered case in S04 (read from files)

power_analysis.method: Monte-Carlo simulation, 10000 replicates, executed and saved BEFORE the confirmatory run
outputs: power of H1 vs number of triggered datasets
minimum triggered datasets for 90% power under the 50% scenario
expected eligible cohort size = required triggered datasets / trigger_rate

pre_specified_secondary_and_diagnostic_a: selection-shift table: v1 choice x v2 choice with mean delta per cell, per dataset and per IR tercile
Oracle regret: bAcc(Oracle) - bAcc(v2) and - bAcc(v1)
negative control: replace the tie-break by a fixed-seed random choice and report the effect
leakage check: confirm every record has test_used_before_selection == false and recompute utility inputs from inner-split fields
REJECTED rate per variant (the balanced-accuracy gate is expected to be more selective than the accuracy gate)
gap to EasyEnsemble reported descriptively (no test, no claim)

status_statement.deferred: S06b (cross-validated utility) and S06c (EasyEnsemble candidate) are NOT part of this protocol; they belong to a separate S07 protocol on a third cohort.
status_statement.this_study: Confirmatory: v2 code and all analysis rules are frozen and deposited BEFORE any confirmatory dataset is downloaded or run.
status_statement.v2_origin: SRDF v2 (changes S06a + S06d) was derived AFTER inspecting failures of v1 on the 45 S04 datasets. Its effect on those datasets is exploratory and optimistic by construction.

stopping_and_deviation_rules.deviation_log: every deviation is written to deviations.json with timestamp and reason; an empty list is reported as such
stopping_and_deviation_rules.early_stopping: only for technical infrastructure failure, never for observed results
stopping_and_deviation_rules.retries: a case/dataset with INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR or INTERRUPTED is resumed; any other status is terminal

title: Confirmatory evaluation of SRDF v2 (tie-break + balanced-accuracy utility) on an independent cohort
